question: Which of the following diseases is caused by Helicobacter pyroli?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gastritis.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Helicobacter pylori** are bacteria that can cause an infection in the stomach or duodenum (first part of the small intestine).
 
• It's the most common cause of **peptic ulcer disease.**
 
• H. pylori can also inflame and irritate the **stomach lining (gastritis).**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Chikungunya virus** is transmitted to people through bites of Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes.
 
• **Rubella** is a mild viral infection that mostly affects children.
 
 
• It is also called German measles or three days measles.
 
 
 
• **Ringworm **is caused by a type of fungus that eats keratin
 
 
• The fungus that causes ringworm is called Microsporum.
